profile.headline: Software Engineer experienced in algorithms, generative design, 3d geometry, and web development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer for the Live Build MFG slicer software
- Separated the concepts of loading a "project" vs loading a "model," allowing the slicer to handle the same file in different ways.
- Implemented file encryption for our project files, obscuring the data inside and preventing tampering.
- Fixed bugs such as our custom supports feature not copying the custom support properly when the part was cloned and fixing model ordering when reloading a project file.
- Performed UI/UX tasks such as persisting settings and providing the user more data, making the application easier to use.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Qt · Software Design · Jenkins · Jira · User Experience (UX) · Debugging

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer for Higharc Studio homebuilding design software.
- Refactored the old PDF-based test suite to a suite based on model data, increasing the speed and reliability of testing.
- Converted construction document generation to a dynamic method, providing greater flexibility in construction document generation.
- Modified custom UI components such as data tables, where I implemented column width resizing.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Linux · Git · CircleCI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer for Live Sinter™ simulation software and Live Inspect™ tolerance analysis software.
- Designed a set of drag handles for rotating and translating models from scratch, 
- Developed a method of rendering detailed meshes based on the simulated model's deformations in the sintering simulation.
- Created a web application that consumes scans of sintered models as input and processes them in Live Sinter to get a set of calibration parameters for the desired material in the simulation.
- Implemented algorithms to connect feature surfaces on CAD models to patches of triangles on scanned models, allowing their tolerances to be tested.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Algorithm Design · Software Design · Pycharm · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Visual Studio · Git · JavaScript · Webstorm

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Developer for Live Parts™ growth-based generative design software from initial design phase through release.
* Won gold metal for software at 2019 Design World LEAP Awards.
* Co-inventor on patent: "System and Methods for Growth-Based Design" - US-11281820-B2

- Ported the rendering logic into its own thread, separated from the simulation logic, after having been 100% single-threaded. This sped up user interaction by a factor of ~50-100x on more complex models - the UI went from upwards of 5 seconds per frame late into the simulation to 30-60 frames per second.
- Implemented a save/load system using Google's Protocol Buffers that allowed models to be reloaded mid-growth.
- Designed a "Pre-smoothing" stage for our models, allowing for Laplacian smoothing to be applied more effectively, excluding the areas we did not want smoothed.
- Updated the UI framework to a more up-to-date IMGUI version.

(Co-ops 12 months, balance part-time/on-call)
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Software Development · Algorithm Design · Multithreading · Visual Studio · Git · User Interface Design · OpenGL · Protocol Buffers

projects.title: Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator Modding
projects.description:
Developed 3 mods for the game Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator
- Record Shuffler - Currently, records in the game loop over their single track repeatedly. This mod makes the record player shuffle through all records on the table next to it, leaving out any records removed from that table.
- Bonfire - This mod increases the difficulty of the game by implementing various features such as an overhaul to the engine/pressure system, range limitation, an addiction to caffeine, and a stagger backwards after firing.
- Teleprinter Fix - There exists a glitch in the game (at time of writing) that causes the game's teleprinters to fail after writing about 16k+ characters. This mod fixes that glitch, allowing the infinite missions to last far longer.
